title: Houston finds hidden stones and senses their energy

tellings.quote: his room a little bit later and he had lined these three stones up on his bedside table

plain: A nonspeaking young man in Atlanta named Houston Asher found stones that had been hidden and seemed to sense their energy: a little later his mother found he "had lined these three stones up on his bedside table." She is Katie Asher, who tells Michels about her own son. Houston was featured in The Telepathy Tapes, a podcast documentary about nonspeaking people said to read minds, and she tells it as a sign that he perceives things he was never told.
